name: Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Requires level 50 instead of 51. From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
Your war in the heart of Alterac means nothing to the Syndicate, champion. We will do as we have always done: Wait until a clear victor rises from the ashes and rubble of this madness and then strike.

That, however, is not why we are here now. The All Seeing Eye has been lost - taken by the Winterax trolls of the region.

Recover the Eye and our services shall be yours - for whatever time remains for your side.

Return to me once you acquire the eye so that I may examine you.

<Master Ryson grins.>
narrative.objectives: Recover Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye from the Winterax caves and return it to Master Ryson.
narrative.endText: Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye Recovered
